prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original isolated transparent-background emblem for the airport destination selection panel in the Brazilian board game Império Urbano. Premium vibrant illustrated 3D cartoon game art, emerald green, deep ocean blue, fine champagne gold, warm Brazilian sunshine. Main subject: one attractive white passenger airplane with blue and green accents flying diagonally upward, entire plane visible including all wings and tail, above a compact blue circular enamel medallion with a simple gold route arc ending in a prominent green-and-gold destination map pin. One tiny simplified airport runway motif on the base, not a detailed airport scene. A restrained gold outline and two small tropical leaves at the lower edge tie it to the Brazilian board game's other emerald-and-gold emblems. Crisp silhouette and large plane, readable as a 26px icon. Clean refined painterly 3D rendering, controlled polished highlights, no clutter. Square composition, only small transparent margins. No Olympic rings, no laurels, no trophy, no real airline brand or logo, no flags on wings, no lettering, no numbers, no buttons, no panel, no background landscape, no watermark. True transparent background outside the emblem and through all negative space.
